records.statement: XRP Insights' Oct30 08:00 UTC daily same-wallet change is -207.3M XRP across the tracked exchange universe. The five-wallet Binance incident transfer was 233.4619431M XRP at Oct29 20:05–20:09 UTC, between the Oct29 08:00 and Oct30 08:00 snapshots. The -207.3M aggregate is 88.8% of the transfer amount and is a strong temporal/magnitude lead, but it is not Binance-specific and cannot be attributed to the theft without a per-exchange/per-wallet crosswalk. The 26.16M arithmetic difference is not assigned to any flow.

Do not equate XRP Insights' -234.9M seven-day all-exchange change, its -173.2M Binance-specific seven-day change, and CryptoQuant's earlier approximately -220M Binance reserve decline. They have different exchange coverage, wallet universes, snapshot windows and reserve definitions. The theft's 233.46M amount is not reconciled to any of these aggregate series.
